diagrams.title: Device Onboarding Sequence
diagrams.code:
@startuml
participant SQS
participant "Rules Engine"
participant "AWSIoT \n Via MQTT"
participant LACE
participant Installer
actor WatersEmployee
boundary DeviceManagementHub
participant DeviceManagementAS
boundary DeviceManagementApp
autonumber
== 0. Register Certificate Authority for the tenancy ==
WatersEmployee -> DeviceManagementHub : Tenancy Creation Workflow
DeviceManagementHub -> DeviceManagementAS : POST /ca/<tenantID> Create And Register CA for tenancy
DeviceManagementAS -> DeviceAS : POST /ca/<tenantID> 
DeviceAS -> DeviceAS : Create CA Cert
DeviceAS -> AWSIoT : Register CA Cert
AWSIoT --> DeviceAS : OK
DeviceAS --> DeviceManagementAS : OK
DeviceManagementAS  --> DeviceManagementHub :OK
== 1. LACE Certifiate Provisioning ==
Installer -> DeviceManagementAS : POST /provision/<tenantID> GetClaimCertificate
DeviceManagementAS -> DeviceAS : POST /provision/<tenantID> GetClaimCertificate
DeviceAS -> DeviceAS : Create Claim Cert &\n sign with tenancy specific CA
DeviceAS -> AWSIoT : Attach Provisioning policy to Claim cert
AWSIoT --> DeviceAS : OK
DeviceAS --> AWSIoT : Create Provisioning Template 
AWSIoT --> DeviceAS : OK
DeviceAS --> DeviceManagementAS : Claim Certificate & Key
DeviceManagementAS --> Installer : Claim Certificate & Key
Installer -> LACE : adds Claim Certificates to LACE

== 2. Just in Time Registration of LACE ==
LACE -> "AWSIoT \n Via MQTT" : Runs JITR flow to exchange \nclaim certs to device specific certs.\n Create IoT thing
note over "AWSIoT \n Via MQTT": The device specific \ncertificate is INACTIVE
"AWSIoT \n Via MQTT" -> LACE : Device Specific certificate.
"AWSIoT \n Via MQTT" -> "AWSIoT \n Via MQTT" :$aws/provisioning/templates/<>/provision/json/accepted
== 3. GreenGrass Group Creation ==
note over "AWSIoT \n Via MQTT": Create GG Group will be trigerred by \n $aws/provisioning/templates/<>/provision/json/accepted
"AWSIoT \n Via MQTT" -> "AWSIoT \n Via MQTT": Create GG group
"AWSIoT \n Via MQTT" -> "Rules Engine" : Create GG group
"Rules Engine" -> "SQS" : Create GG group.
"SQS" -> DeviceAS : Create GG group 

== 4. Device Certificate Activation ==
WatersEmployee -> DeviceManagementApp : Set Device Certificate ACTIVE
DeviceManagementApp -> DeviceAS : POST /Devices/Activate
DeviceAS -> AWSIoT : Set certificate status ACTIVE
AWSIoT --> DeviceAS: OK
DeviceAS --> DeviceManagementApp: OK 



== 5. Onboard sytems & device certificate policy update ==
LACE -> "AWSIoT \n Via MQTT" : Add systems, parameters: \nLACE ID, CertificateID & system(s)
"AWSIoT \n Via MQTT" -> SQS : Add systems 
SQS -> DeviceAS : create system policy attach to device certificate. \ncreate thing for systems and add in ggcore group.
note left: system policy contains \npermissions to allow\nsystem shadow\ncreate & update
note over SQS: DeviceAS can optionally post \na message to an MQTT topic for \nsuccess of system creation 
@enduml

diagrams.title: Redshift System Monitoring schema — DeviceAS (diagram 1)
diagrams.code:
classDiagram
    class AcquisitionController {
        +varchar source_entity_id
        +varchar tenant_id
        +varchar name
        +varchar status
        +timestamp observed_at
    }
    class InstrumentSystem {
        +varchar source_entity_id
        +varchar tenant_id
        +varchar controller_entity_id
        +varchar name
        +varchar status
        +boolean connected
    }
    class InstrumentSystemComponent {
        +varchar source_entity_id
        +varchar tenant_id
        +varchar name
        +varchar serial_number
        +varchar state
    }
    class ComponentMetric {
        +varchar source_entity_id
        +varchar tenant_id
        +timestamp observed_at
        +varchar metric_name
        +double numeric_value
    }
    class SystemHistoryEvent {
        +varchar source_entity_id
        +varchar tenant_id
        +varchar system_id
        +timestamp observed_at
        +varchar event_type
    }
    class SystemReservation {
        +varchar source_entity_id
        +varchar tenant_id
        +varchar system_id
        +timestamp reservation_start_at
        +timestamp reservation_end_at
    }
    class SystemHistorySegment {
        +varchar source_entity_id
        +varchar tenant_id
        +varchar system_id
        +timestamp starting_at
        +timestamp ending_at
        +varchar timeline_type
    }
    class SystemTag {
        +varchar source_entity_id
        +varchar tenant_id
        +varchar system_id
        +varchar tag_id
        +varchar tag_type
    }
    class RepeatedValue {
        <<child table>>
        +varchar source_entity_id
        +varchar tenant_id
        +integer item_ordinal
        +timestamp exported_at
    }
    class AuditRecord {
        <<external, not exported>>
        +varchar audit_record_id
    }

    AcquisitionController "0..*" --> "0..*" InstrumentSystemComponent : controller_component
    AcquisitionController "1" <-- "0..*" InstrumentSystem : controller_ref
    InstrumentSystem "0..*" --> "0..*" InstrumentSystemComponent : system_component
    InstrumentSystemComponent "1" --> "0..*" ComponentMetric : component_id
    InstrumentSystem "1" --> "0..*" SystemHistoryEvent : system_id
    InstrumentSystem "1" --> "0..*" SystemReservation : system_id
    InstrumentSystem "1" --> "0..*" SystemHistorySegment : system_id
    InstrumentSystem "1" --> "0..*" SystemTag : system_id
    SystemHistoryEvent "0..*" --> "0..*" InstrumentSystemComponent : history_event_component
    SystemReservation "0..*" --> "0..*" InstrumentSystemComponent : reservation_component
    SystemHistorySegment "0..*" --> "0..1" SystemHistoryEvent : starting_event_id
    SystemHistorySegment "0..*" --> "0..1" SystemHistoryEvent : ending_event_id
    SystemTag "0..*" --> "0..*" AuditRecord : audit_reference
    AcquisitionController *-- RepeatedValue
    InstrumentSystem *-- RepeatedValue
    InstrumentSystemComponent *-- RepeatedValue
    ComponentMetric *-- RepeatedValue
    SystemHistoryEvent *-- RepeatedValue
    SystemHistorySegment *-- RepeatedValue
    SystemReservation *-- RepeatedValue
    SystemTag *-- RepeatedValue
